help.search: Search is an exact-match blind-index lookup, so a partial address finds nothing.

review.title: AI suggestion
review.description: Review the generated result before applying it.

brief.title: AI contact brief
brief.intro: Runs a durable {'@'}octabits-io/flow workflow against the scripted in-memory model: fetch, then summary and follow-up draft in parallel.

notes.title: Notes
notes.selectPrompt: Select a note from the list, or create a new one.

fields.title: Title
fields.publicTitleHint: Shown to the customer in their own language. The default language is required; the others show an orange dot until filled.
fields.publicBodyHint: Register variants (DE formal) are optional — leave one blank and it inherits its base language.

help.title: About this list
help.filter: The date filter runs in the browser over the notes already loaded — the API has no date filter of its own.

files.title: Files
files.description: Blobs stored in Postgres by the framework's object-storage provider.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Backed by the framework's scoped config engine — values are validated, encrypted, and cached; unset keys read back their schema default.

hints.welcomeSubject: Overrides the subject of the next welcome email queued from the contacts page.

role.title: Demo role
role.description: Sent as the x-demo-role header on every API call. Writing settings and deleting contacts require admin; pick viewer to see the server's 403 path surfaced through the kit's error messenger.

role.adminHint: Full access — may write settings and delete contacts
role.viewerHint: Read-only — writes come back as the server’s 403

settings.saveHint: Save from the header — the page keeps a single primary action.
settings.subtitle: Scoped config — validated, encrypted, cached
